title: School meals across the Horn of Africa (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: a daily hot meal for children in drought-affected schools.
description: This is fictional demo data used to exercise the donation workflows of this development build. No real programme, beneficiary or payment is involved. A daily school meal keeps children in class and gives families one less meal to find. The campaign serves several countries at once, which is how a single campaign record appears in each country on the map.

title: Drought seed recovery, northern Kenya (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: drought-tolerant seed for smallholder farming households.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Smallholder households that lost a harvest to drought receive drought-tolerant seed and planting advice before the next rains, so the next season does not fail too.

title: Maternal nutrition support in Haiti (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: nutrition support for mothers and children under five.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Pregnant and breastfeeding women receive nutrition counselling and supplements, and infants are screened for acute malnutrition at community clinics.

title: Water points for displaced families, Somalia (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: this one is paused, to show a non-donatable state.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. This campaign is PAUSED so the country list and campaign cards can demonstrate how a campaign that is not accepting donations is presented, and so recommendations can be checked never to include it.

title: Cold storage for farming cooperatives, India (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: stop harvests rotting before they reach a market.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Solar cold storage units are installed next to farming cooperatives so fruit and vegetables survive the trip to market instead of spoiling, raising farm incomes and keeping affordable food in local markets.

title: Surplus produce kitchens, Nairobi (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: redirect surplus produce into community kitchens.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Surplus produce that markets cannot sell is collected daily and cooked into meals by community kitchens in low-income neighbourhoods.

title: Monthly food parcels, Turkana (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: monthly parcels for households that lost their herds.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Households that lost livestock to successive dry seasons receive a monthly parcel of staples while they rebuild, so that a fourth country campaign exists for testing the non-recommended list.

title: Emergency rations for displaced families, Somalia (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: ready-to-eat rations for families arriving at displacement sites.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Families arriving at displacement sites receive ready-to-eat rations within hours, then move onto monthly food parcels once they are registered.

title: Mobile kitchens, South Sudan (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: hot meals cooked on site for newly displaced people.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Mobile kitchens cook hot meals on site for people who have just arrived and have no means to cook, with priority for pregnant women and young children.

title: School gardens in Ethiopia (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: school gardens that supply the school kitchen.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. Schools plant and run their own gardens, supplying the kitchen with vegetables and teaching pupils growing techniques they take home.

title: Market food vouchers, Haiti — completed (demo)
summary: Demo campaign: finished, to show a closed campaign in the list.
description: Fictional demo data for this development build. This campaign is COMPLETED so the UI can demonstrate a closed campaign that is listed but cannot receive new donations, and that recommendations never suggest it.
